summary: Comprehensive testing of Homepage redesign (Modern Luxe style), Admin Panel Menu Management, and Pickup page DB integration. All features working correctly including the admin->frontend flow where menu items added in admin reflect in Pickup page with proper regional pricing.
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage Modern Luxe design is well implemented with parallax hero, service cards, featured dishes, testimonials slider, and locations section
Admin panel uses proper JWT authentication and manages menu items with both INR and AUD pricing
Pickup page correctly fetches menu from database with fallback to JSON config
Regional pricing works correctly - India shows INR, Australia shows AUD
seed_data_creation: Test menu item 'TEST_Automated Test Item' was created and deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are fully functional. Backend has 173 menu items in database with INR/AUD dual pricing.
